<function name="GetColor" parent="DModelPanel" type="panelfunc">
	<description>Returns the color of the rendered entity.</description>
	<realm>Client</realm>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="Color">The color of the entity.</ret>
	</rets>
</function>

<example>
	<description>Prints out the default entity color.</description>
	<code>
local mdl = vgui.Create("DModelPanel")
mdl:SetPos(20, 20)
mdl:SetSize(200, 200)
mdl:SetModel("models/props_junk/watermelon01.mdl")

print(mdl:GetColor())
	</code>
	<output>
```
255 255 255 255
```
</output>

</example>
